observations: Single photo shows a closed, box-shaped game console with a custom red and white vinyl skin bearing a Liverpool FC crest and text 'You'll Never Walk Alone'.
A 'SHOW GAMES' watermark overlays the image, suggesting it was pulled from another listing or watermarked by a reseller.
No pads, games, cables, receipt, or power-on screen are visible in the photo.
The shape and proportions are consistent with an original PS4 ('Fat') body, matching the seller's phrase 'PS4 big', but no model plate or serial is visible to confirm.

claims.evidence: No discs, game cases, or console menu/game list shown.
No cables, power brick, or HDMI shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Internal condition cannot be seen from an exterior photo of a closed, skinned console.
No power-on test, no close-up of ports, no video of operation.
No receipt or paperwork shown in the photo.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have internal issues (e.g. overheating, dead ports) despite seller's claim.
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on, reaching the home screen, and running a game for a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / high-risk unit

risks.risk: Accessories (2 pads, 7 games, cables) may not actually be included or may differ from described.
risks.proof: A single photo showing the console, both controllers, all 7 game cases/discs, and cables laid out together.

risks.risk: Custom skin may be hiding scuffs, cracks, or a modified/hacked shell that affects resale value or legality.
risks.proof: A photo with the skin partially peeled or removed showing the bare shell and any visible model/serial sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown condition, treated as cosmetically compromised

risks.risk: System may be jailbroken/hacked rather than running original firmware, which affects both price tier and resale risk (bricking, no official updates).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system settings/firmware version menu.
risks.if_unproven: priced in line with 'hacked' console comparables, not original-firmware ones

risks.risk: UK origin and receipt claim cannot be confirmed, affecting trust in provenance and voltage/region compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual UK purchase receipt with matching serial number visible on the console.
risks.if_unproven: provenance treated as unverified, no premium applied

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game to confirm it works and does not overheat.
Photo of both controllers, all 7 games, and included accessories laid out together.
Photo of the system settings menu showing firmware version (to confirm hacked vs original).
Photo of the UK receipt with a serial number matching the console.
Close-up photos of the ports and any part of the shell with the skin lifted to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a customized PS4 Fat console, but every functional and accessory claim is unverified from a single skin-covered exterior photo, so it must be priced at worst case against the cheapest comparable 'hacked/unverified working' listings until proof is given.
